subject: german
title: Stretch: Numbers, Dates & Colourful Detail
welcome_lead: Push beyond 20 — say your birthday in German, talk about colour shades, and impress the examiner with detail.
meta_desc: Stretch GCSE German vocab: bigger numbers, dates, and richer colour descriptions.
final_note: Top marks territory! Examiners reward range — drop in 'hellblau' or 'am dritten Juni' for instant impact.

concepts.def: On the first of May — ordinal + month.
Birthday — masculine noun, use 'am' for date.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Germans say the units first: einundzwanzig = 'one-and-twenty' (21).

Pattern: digit + und + tens. So 35 = fünfunddreißig.

Tens: zwanzig (20), dreißig (30 — note ß), vierzig, fünfzig, sechzig, siebzig, achtzig, neunzig, hundert.

Ordinal numbers add -ten: erste(n), zweite(n), dritte(n).

To give a date: Mein Geburtstag ist am dritten Juli (My birthday is on the 3rd of July).

The am requires the dative ending -en.

Prefix hell- (light) or dunkel- (dark) onto a colour.

Examples: hellblau (light blue), dunkelgrün (dark green), hellrot (light red).

Useful for clothes and home descriptions: Ich trage ein hellblaues T-Shirt.
